Chhattisgarh Government Bans Conocarpus Erectus Plantation

The Chhattisgarh government has imposed a ban on the plantation of Conocarpus Erectus trees. This decision prohibits the planting of any new Conocarpus Erectus saplings within the state. The ban was announced by the government, which stated that no further plantations of this species will be allowed.
